window: Indian theatrical releases, 30 Oct to 9 Nov 2026 (the 8 films idly tracked)
rule: A rating counts if it comes from idly's fixed panel of Indian English-language outlets, gives a number, was published on or after the film's India release, and was confirmed on the outlet's page or in two independent listings.
method: Panel fixed once for all 8 films (below). A rating counts if: the outlet is on the panel; the review prints a numeric rating; it was published on or after the film's India theatrical release date; and idly confirmed it on the outlet's own page, or, where that page could not be opened, in two independent listings that agree (thereviewmonk, Rotten Tomatoes, Sacnilk Review-of-Reviews, BollyMovieReviewz). Outlet pages read earlier on 10 Nov by the v4 research or by idly's blind reviewer (lane report) are recorded as such. Ratings converted to /10 (x/5 x 2); score = mean, rounded half up to one decimal. A film is ranked if it has 4 or more counted ratings. No page was fetched with curl, wget or requests; pages WebFetch declined are recorded as unreachable. Search coverage: WebSearch in this session returns titles and URLs only and does not index several outlets (Hindustan Times, Filmfare, The Tribune, ABP Live, Rediff pages did not surface); each film's sources_checked lists what was searched. Panel outlets in no_rated_review_found were not seen with a rated review in any of those sources.
